shared.title: What the King Has Left
shared.tone: Tense, street-level, a district holding its breath; banter in safe rooms, crime register when shutters come down.
shared.promise: With Daigo blind and his captains gone, can the crew hold the places it made famous without becoming the next racket on Neon Lantern Street?
shared.premise: All four pillars are down and Daigo can no longer see Kobuncho. His captains' rackets are up for grabs, and the places the crew's fights made famous are the easiest targets in the district.
shared.pressure: Daigo can't see, can't pay and trusts no one, so the muscle he has left hits what it can find. The Shirogane Crew and the Honebi Collective race for the old protection money, the shop owners are caught between, and every public fight draws police and Academy attention.
set_pieces: a crawl through a place off every map
a street clash between two rival claimants
a two-front night with the brothers apart
shared.subplot: Kobuncho's kids are being recruited by whoever pays first, and Riko's dream of a gym for kids who can't pay stops being a someday.
shared.climax_kind: a hold-the-line night for the crew's home ground
seeds: a shop wrecked overnight, shutters still locked
couriers asking who protects the shops now
wins_on_offer: the shop-owner alliance as a sworn ally
a map of Kobuncho's old routes
the district's word that the crew protects without charging
echoes: Jostin toasted Kobuncho and allied with its shop owners on opening night.
Jostin asked Ayame to shortlist HearthOps candidates so he can open his cafe.
Whatever the crew chose for the archive and its captain at the end of Arc 4.
backstory_hooks: Jovian's sheet: a known street delinquent who survived on improvisation; the district's young hustlers live the life he came from.
Riko's dream of a gym for kids who can't pay.
Iori Vale died in Jostin's arms at Daigo's audition.
deviations: Act 3 opens the day Arc 4 ends (about Day 85), not Day 121: Act 2 is event-based and closed when the last pillar fell.

twist.text: Daigo's last fists move through the old service network under Kobuncho (the Maintenance Sub-Level under the annex, The House's floor), and the bathhouse line linking Lumiere to Yuzuki's bathhouse joins it: the home has a door nobody knew was open.

fronts.name: Daigo's last fists
fronts.goal: Show Kobuncho that nothing the Joestars protect is safe.

moves.text: Wrecks a shop that sided with the crew, from below.
Breaks the gym's truce: collects old House debts from Tetsu Gym's kids.
Takes someone the crew chose (a hostess, a shop family, a gym kid) into the dark as a message.
Comes up under Lumiere on a night the brothers are apart.

fronts.name: The vacuum
fronts.goal: Own the pillars' protection money before the crew or Daigo can.

moves.text: Honebi circles collect fast on the side streets, rumor first.
Shirogane courts the alliance with sponsorships and edited clips painting the crew as the next syndicate.
The two crews clash in the street, shops in between.
One of them offers the crew a split of the rackets.

fronts.name: The leash and the heat
fronts.goal: Keep Chikara students out of a district war and close the jackets case.

moves.text: Police canvass the hit sites and ask about the gym's ambulance call.
Rei carries Anya's warning: one report with a student's face and the filing is reviewed.
Renji Kuroba turns up in Kobuncho, watching the brothers for Anya.

antagonist.name: Daigo Renjiro
antagonist.face: Captain Kageyama, the House's old overseer whom Jostin staggered in the humming room, now running the ten-win fighters Daigo has left.
antagonist.first_contact: Within the first third he walks into a place the crew made famous (Tetsu Gym's front or Lumiere's lounge), keys on his belt, and says the old terms are back on Daigo's word.

clues.text: Hit sites sit on old service lines: cellar hatches unbolted from below.
Sato's keyring, with Gara since Ep 6, opens service doors on the old route sheet; its keys match Kageyama's ring.
Masaru's notebook maps mark maintenance doors near the gym and Shutter Alley that no city map shows.
Bathhouse regulars hear iron doors under the floor at night.

surprises: Daiki, whom Jostin freed, runs with a Honebi circle (Arcanum seed).
Okabe's knowledge of Kobuncho's debts turns up in a claimant's hands.
Late only: Daigo seen once, still, at the far end of Neon Lantern Street; no lines.
climax_options: hold home ground through one night
carry the fight down and seal the way in under Lumiere
drag it into the street before the shop owners, at police and Academy cost
take the routes for themselves and become the new gatekeeper

pc_test_situations.Jostin Joestar: Lumiere and the gym are hit the same night; Maki asks whether the club is safe.
pc_test_situations.Jovian Joestar: The shop owners offer the dues they once paid Daigo, and a claimant offers a split: what is the crew's turf for?

showcase.kind: close-quarters fight in sealed, lightless sections below the district
showcase.rule: A door, gate or grate he locks with a key from his ring can't be opened or broken while the key stays turned.
showcase.tell: He counts keys aloud like a warden; the ring chimes once as a seal takes.
showcase.weakness: One lock per key, only while the key stays in; he must reach each door himself and fights one-handed with the ring in his off hand.
showcase.if_it_goes_badly: A section is lost; the way under Lumiere stays reachable.

new_npcs.name: Sumire Kuze
new_npcs.intro: Shirogane Crew event organizer; sponsors smiles, edits rumors.

new_npcs.name: Tobi
new_npcs.intro: Honebi circle runner, seventeen, fast scooter, faster mouth; owes nobody.

refine: When Arc 4 closes, collapse the fork branches in notes to the played pick.
hidden.notes: Seat: HearthOps over Arcanum, since Jostin asked for HearthOps candidates (t475), the seat holds base and school (canon f047), and the pressure is on home ground. Candidate: Masaru Hachiya (gym regular, notebook maps), earned by asking Tetsu, not poaching, and proving the gym is safer with the crew; a missed search leads to Natsumi Arai. Fork: if burned, Shirogane's clips go unanswered; if police and press, the heat front is louder and Haruto's file is asked about; if kept, Shirogane wants it and Haruto and Reiko press the racket question. Captain arrested: bargains with police; escaped: sells to a claimant; turned: Daigo's fists hunt him to the crew's door. Weakest point answered: fronts come to the crew, clues point at reachable places, a missed clue becomes a front move, never a cold lead. Scenes 4 turns max; prep 3; 3-turn finale; no tail. Spotlight: Reiko fronts the families; Mikoto faces House veterans who know Banda died to her Riot Pulse. Areas: Kobuncho/Maintenance Sub-Level and old bathhouse exist; add-area for new sections when shown. Kageyama was left for police after Tag Night (story-so-far call) and made bail before Finance fell. Planner review: NPCs, the area and canon f047 checked; no PC or combat outcome in any field.
